params._data: Encoded redemption data containing collateral IDs and values

returns._burnIds: Array of collateral token IDs to burn (empty)
returns._burnValues: Array of amounts to burn for each collateral ID (empty)
returns._ids: Array of collateral token IDs to redeem
returns._values: Array of amounts for each collateral ID to redeem

params._nonce: Nonce value to use for short name registration

params._flag: Advanced usage flag value to set

setFeeCollection(address).details: The fee collection address must not be zero. Only owner can change.

params._enabled: Whether to enable (true) or disable (false) the condition

setMinimalDeposit(uint256).details: Must not exceed MAX_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_MINIMUM. Only owner can change.

setMintHandler(address).details: The mintHandler contract can be zero address. Only owner can change the mintHandler contract.

setRedemptionHandler(address).details: The redemptionHandler contract can be zero address. Only owner can change the redemptionHandler contract.

setService(address).details: The service account must be a non-zero address. Only owner can change the service address.

params._service: Updated service address to give trustBatch privilege to.

params._coreMembers: Array of core member addresses to trust/untrust
params._expiry: Trust expiry timestamp. If >= current timestamp, trust core member.        If < current timestamp, untrust only currently trusted core members (to avoid        accidentally trusting new core members for a single block).

MAX_CONDITIONS().notice: The maximum number of membership conditions allowed.

MAX_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_MINIMUM().notice: maximum minimal amount for deposit to avoid inefficient redemption bookkeeping.

beforeBurnPolicy(address,address,uint256.notice: Simple burn policy that always returns true

beforeMintPolicy(address,address,uint256.notice: Policy that registers minting of circles to track membership in group.

beforeRedeemPolicy(address,address,addre.notice: Policy that validates and processes redemption of Circles tokens

feeCollection().notice: Returns the address that receives fees collected by this group

minimalDeposit().notice: returns the minimal deposit amount for mints. The same minimal         amount must remain in the vault collateral in order to track         the id as active collateral for searches for redemption

mintHandler().notice: returns the mintHandler for the CM Group to assist with         automatic path-mints for the group.

owner().notice: Owner address. This is a copied value of ERC1967 ADMIN_SLOT         if this group mastercopy is consumed by an ERC1967 proxy.         For simplicity and readability we duplicate owner with ERC1967 admin,         even if for the intended deployment they are the same address.

redemptionHandler().notice: returns the redemptionHandler for the CM Group to facilitate         redemptions either direct or over paths.

registerShortName().notice: Registers a short name for this group in the name registry

registerShortNameWithNonce(uint256).notice: Registers a short name for this group with a specified nonce

service().notice: Service address. The service is limited to trusting (or untrusting) avatars.

setAdvancedUsageFlag(bytes32).notice: Sets advanced usage flags for this group in the Hub

setMembershipCondition(address,bool).notice: Enable or disable a membership condition contract

setMinimalDeposit(uint256).notice: Change minimal deposit amount for the group

setMintHandler(address).notice: Change the mintHandler contract address. MintHandler contract helps         automate path minting/redemptions.

setRedemptionHandler(address).notice: Change the redemptionHandler contract address. RedemptionHandler contract helps         track deposits and redemptions for the group.

setService(address).notice: Change the service address. Service account is able to trust/untrust core members         alongside the owner.

trust(address,uint96).notice: trust allows the owner to explicitly set trust relations         for the group.

trustBatch(address[],uint96).notice: Trust or untrust a batch of core members.

updateMetadataDigest(bytes32).notice: Updates the metadata digest for this group in the name registry
